title: Magnify instance
description: Per-template schema for magnify. Core TemplateConfig fields (theme/global) are $ref-d from the global animations.schema.json. This template does NOT own content — it magnifies arbitrary `children` passed by the caller, so `elements[]` is unconstrained (any id) and typically empty. extras.* are extended here.

elements.description: Currently unused by magnify itself — content is passed as `children` to <Magnify>. Kept in the schema for DeepConfig pipeline compatibility.

color.description: HUD accent color as [r, g, b] in 0-1 range. Tints the reticle, readout, and ripple outline

follow.description: How quickly the lens follows the cursor script (0 to 1). 1 snaps to the eased path

hud.description: Overall HUD intensity (0 to 1). 0 hides every reticle element

crosshair.description: Show the crosshair lines through the center

ticks.description: Show the tick marks around the ring

brackets.description: Show the corner brackets inside the lens

grid.description: Show a faint measurement grid inside the lens

readout.description: Show the data readout beside the lens (X/Y/zoom/size + blinking dot)

aberration.description: Chromatic aberration split inside the lens (0 to 3). 0 disables it

haze.description: Dreamy insight haze inside the lens (0 to 1). Softens and lifts the magnified content

ripples.description: Emit a ripple across the page on click

rippleSpeed.description: How fast the ripple wavefront travels, in CSS pixels per second

rippleWidth.description: Thickness of the colored ripple outline in CSS pixels

rippleBendWidth.description: Width of the band the ripple bends, in CSS pixels

rippleBend.description: How many CSS pixels the ripple bends the page

rippleGlow.description: Strength of the colored ripple outline (0 to 2). 0 hides it

rippleLife.description: Seconds a ripple lives before it fades out

cursor.description: The scripted cursor: the lens's scene-time script. `start` is where the cursor sits when the composition begins (normalized 0-1 of the frame; values outside the frame are allowed for enter/exit). `enter`/`leave` are the composition progress (0-1) at which the lens fades in and out (damped, like a real cursor). `moves` is the ordered list of moves — each has a destination (`to` with absolute x/y, or relative dx/dy offsets from the previous arrival), an arrival time (`at`, composition progress), an optional `start` (progress the move begins — default: the previous move's `at`, or 0 for the first), an optional `ease` (one of the global easingName names) or `bezier` ([x1,y1,x2,y2] cubic-bezier, overrides ease) for the non-linear movement between positions, and an optional `click` that fires when the cursor reaches the position. `clicks` is an optional list of standalone clicks (independent of moves) — each with `at` (composition progress), `hold` (seconds held), `release` (seconds to ease the magnification back), `count` (repeats: 2 = double-click), `zoom` (magnification multiplier while held), `ripple` (emit the ripple ring). A click presses the lens: the magnification punches up while held and the ripple bends the page

x.description: Normalized horizontal cursor start (0-1 across the frame)

y.description: Normalized vertical cursor start, CSS y-down (0 = top, 1 = bottom)

enter.description: Composition progress (0-1) at which the lens fades in (presence ramps up damped, like a real cursor entering the page)

leave.description: Composition progress (0-1) at which the lens fades out

moves.description: The ordered cursor moves. List order IS the chain order (relative moves resolve against the previous arrival) — keep `at` increasing. The cursor holds at `start` until the first move, holds at each arrival until the next move's `start`, and holds at the final arrival to the end. Missing/empty = a static cursor at `start`

to.description: Destination: absolute x/y (normalized 0-1 of the frame; outside 0-1 moves the cursor off-frame) OR relative dx/dy (offsets from the previous arrival; absolute wins on conflict; a missing axis keeps the previous value)

x.description: Absolute horizontal destination (0-1 across the frame)

y.description: Absolute vertical destination, CSS y-down (0 = top, 1 = bottom)

dx.description: Relative horizontal offset from the previous arrival (fraction of the frame width)

dy.description: Relative vertical offset from the previous arrival (fraction of the frame height, CSS y-down)

at.description: Composition progress (0-1) at which the cursor ARRIVES at this destination

start.description: Composition progress (0-1) at which this move begins. Default: the previous move's `at` (0 for the first). A gap between the previous `at` and this `start` holds the cursor at the previous arrival — a pause

ease.description: The non-linear movement function for this move. Default: ease-out-cubic

bezier.description: Custom cubic-bezier easing [x1, y1, x2, y2] for this move — overrides `ease`. x1/x2 should stay in 0-1; y may overshoot for a springy arrival (e.g. [0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1])

click.description: A click that fires when the cursor reaches this position (at this move's `at`). Presses the lens: magnification punches up while held and a ripple bends the page

at.description: Composition progress when the click fires. Default: this move's `at` (on arrival)

release.description: Seconds to ease the magnification back to `zoom` after release

zoom.description: Magnification multiplier while held (punch = zoom x this, clamped to 4)

ripple.description: Emit the ripple ring on press (requires extras.ripples)

clicks.description: Standalone clicks, independent of the moves — fire at any composition progress (e.g. a double-click mid-move, or a click while the cursor rests). Same shape as a move's nested `click`, but `at` is required

at.description: Composition progress when the click fires

release.description: Seconds to ease the magnification back to `zoom` after release

zoom.description: Magnification multiplier while held (punch = zoom x this, clamped to 4)

ripple.description: Emit the ripple ring on press (requires extras.ripples)
